L01_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L01_narrator.wav.text: I usually wake up at six thirty in the morning.

L02_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L02_narrator.wav.text: I try not to look at my phone right away when I wake up.

L03_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L03_narrator.wav.text: Instead, I get out of bed and drink a glass of water.

L04_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L04_narrator.wav.text: Then I go to the kitchen to make some fresh coffee.

L05_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L05_narrator.wav.text: The smell of coffee always helps me wake up properly.

L06_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L06_narrator.wav.text: While the coffee is brewing, I make a quick breakfast.

L07_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L07_narrator.wav.text: I often eat some toast with a little butter on it.

L08_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L08_narrator.wav.text: After eating, I wash the dishes and clean up the table.

L09_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L09_narrator.wav.text: Next, I take a quick shower and brush my teeth.

L10_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L10_narrator.wav.text: I choose my clothes and put them on before seven thirty.

L11_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L11_narrator.wav.text: Before leaving the house, I make sure that I have my keys.

L12_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L12_narrator.wav.text: I walk to the train station to catch the eight o'clock train.
